headline: Google’s Pixel 11 phone preorders come with up to $350 in gift cards
summary: Google has officially launched its new Pixel 11 series phones and watches. Preorders for the Pixel 11 phones are available with gift card incentives up to $350. Pricing starts at $899 for the base Pixel 11, with Pro, Pro XL, and Fold models also available.

headline: Twitch streamers can now opt out from training Amazon’s AI
summary: Twitch now allows streamers to opt out of having their content used for Amazon's generative AI training. Opting out prevents streams, VODs, clips, chats, and channel content from being used. This feature gives content creators control over their data's use in AI development.

headline: How Google’s new Pixel 11 phones compare to last year’s models
summary: Google introduced four new Pixel 11 phones: the 11, 11 Pro, 11 Pro XL, and 11 Pro Fold. The new models are slightly more expensive but feature significant upgrades. Key improvements include enhanced cameras and the faster new Tensor G6 chip.

headline: ICE wants to give agents electrified gloves that shock people into compliance
summary: ICE plans to spend up to $20 million on specialized electrified gloves for agents. These gloves are designed to deliver painful electric shocks to individuals. The Department of Homeland Security outlined these plans for device delivery by March.

headline: Christopher Judge Slams God of War TV Series Showrunners For Not Hiring Writers of the Games
summary: Kratos actor Christopher Judge criticized the God of War TV series showrunners. He expressed disappointment that the game's original writers were not involved in the adaptation. Judge advocates for including original creators in video game adaptations.

headline: The New 2026 Hisense U6 Pro TV Delivers Premium Tech and the Latest Gaming Features at a Budget Price
summary: Hisense announced the new 2026 U6 Pro TV, offering premium features at a budget price. Improvements over previous models include a brighter picture and an anti-glare screen. The TV also boasts a built-in subwoofer, enhancing its gaming capabilities.

headline: Reacher Season 4 Review
summary: Reacher Season 4 has been reviewed. The review highlights Reacher's characteristic ability to ensure justice. The season maintains the protagonist's reputation for holding wrongdoers accountable.

headline: Twitch Now Trains Amazon's Generative AI Models On Your Channel By Default
summary: Twitch has implemented a new feature that defaults to training Amazon's AI on user channels. This means user content is automatically used for generative AI model development. Users can disable this setting, but it is enabled by default.

headline: Major Russian grain export terminals hit in Ukraine Black Sea port attack
summary: Ukraine has attacked major Russian grain export terminals in the Black Sea. This follows previous attacks on shipping facilities by both Russia and Ukraine. Grain exports from both nations are declining due to ongoing port attacks.

headline: Ann Widdecombe's loved ones gather for her funeral
summary: A requiem mass was held for former MP Ann Widdecombe. Loved ones gathered at Buckfast Abbey in Devon for the service. The funeral took place near her Dartmoor home.

headline: Double killer and rapist given whole life sentence
summary: Simon Levy from Tottenham received a whole life sentence. He was convicted for the murder of two women. Levy was also found guilty of raping a third woman.

headline: Burnham urges shops not to sell disposable BBQs over wildfire risks
summary: Prime Minister Burnham urged shops to stop selling disposable BBQs. The plea is due to the heightened risk of wildfires. The public is advised against using single-use grills during the dry weather.
